albums.blurb: Emahoy Tsegué-Maryam Guèbrou (1923–2023) was an Ethiopian nun, pianist and composer who spent most of her life in monasteries in Ethiopia and, from the mid-1980s, Jerusalem. Her solo piano pieces fold Ethiopian pentatonic modes and Orthodox liturgical melody into a rubato, Chopin-and-Satie-tinged romanticism that sits in no genre comfortably. She originally self-released these recordings, made from 1963 onward, to raise money for charity; this 2006 volume of Buda Musique's Éthiopiques series collected sixteen of them and introduced her music to the wider world. The whole record is unaccompanied piano, with no vocals of any kind.
albums.reception: The collection brought her international recognition late in life: Norah Jones told The New York Times in 2020 that it was "one of the most beautiful things I've ever heard," and her recordings went on to score Garrett Bradley's Oscar-nominated documentary Time.

albums.album: Songs from a Thousand Frames of Mind
albums.blurb: Kate Bollinger is a songwriter from Charlottesville, Virginia, who built a following through a run of EPs — most recently Look at it in the Light (2022) — before releasing this debut full-length on Ghostly International in September 2024. The record is sequenced to feel like a mixtape, moving through 1960s-leaning pop, soft rock and folk in eleven short songs, polished on the surface but scrappy underneath.
albums.reception: Northern Transmissions scored the album 8.1, calling it "an exciting and delightful treat."

albums.blurb: Nourished by Time is the project of Baltimore songwriter and producer Marcus Brown, who wrote, performed and produced this debut album himself and released it on Scenic Route Records in April 2023. It runs 1980s R&B, new jack swing and freestyle through a lo-fi DIY filter, with Brown's baritone carrying songs about love and precarity. The album's breakout led to a deal with XL Recordings, which released the follow-up EP Catching Chickens in 2024 and the album The Passionate Ones in 2025.
albums.reception: Pitchfork designated the album Best New Music, and it was widely placed on year-end lists of the best albums of 2023.
